```{r}
source(here::here("3-scripts", "0-setup.r"))

do_rast <- terra::rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "do_ipdw.rds")))
sal_rast <- terra::rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "sal_ipdw.rds")))
turb_rast <- terra::rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "turb_ipdw.rds")))
water_temp_rast <- terra::rast(readRDS(here::here("2-data", "models", "water_temp_ipdw.rds")))
depth_rast <- terra::rast(here::here("2-data", "processed", "depth_rast.rds"))
sed_rast <- terra::rast(here::here("2-data", "processed", "sed_rast.rds"))
occ <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "oyster_pts_0903.rds" ))

target_crs <- "ESRI:103021"
```


```{r}
do_rast <- terra::resample(
  do_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

sal_rast <- terra::resample(
  sal_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

turb_rast <- terra::resample(
  turb_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

water_temp_rast <- terra::resample(
  water_temp_rast,
  depth_rast,
  method = "bilinear"
)

occ <- sf::st_transform(
  occ,
  "ESRI:103021"
)

occ_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(occ)
```

```{r}

# Convert terra predictors to raster::RasterStack
predictors_raster <- raster::stack(
  raster::raster(do_rast),
  raster::raster(sal_rast),
  raster::raster(turb_rast),
  raster::raster(water_temp_rast),
  raster::raster(depth_rast),
  raster::raster(sed_rast)
)

names(predictors_raster) <- c(
  "dissolved_oxygen",
  "salinity",
  "turbidity",
  "water_temperature",
  "depth",
  "sediment"
)

```

```{r}
# create mask to  background points
mask_terra <- terra::rast(predictors_raster[[1]])

# Rasterize study area polygon
mask_terra <- terra::rasterize(
  terra::vect(study_area),
  mask_terra,
  field = 1,
  background = NA
)

# Convert for dismo
mask <- raster::raster(mask_terra)
crs(mask) = target_crs

set.seed(42)

bg <- dismo::randomPoints(
  mask = mask,
  n = 5000,
  p = occ_xy,
  excludep = TRUE
)

plot(bg)

```

```{r}
occ_cv <- occ_xy %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    pb = 1
  )

bg_cv <- data.frame(
  x = bg[, 1],
  y = bg[, 2],
  pb = 0
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = target_crs
  )

cv_pts <- rbind(
  occ_cv,
  bg_cv
)
```

# Determine Spatial Auto Correlation to determine fold size
```{r}
continuous_predictors <- c(
  do_rast,
  sal_rast,
  turb_rast,
  water_temp_rast,
  depth_rast
)

names(continuous_predictors) <- c(
  "dissolved_oxygen",
  "salinity",
  "turbidity",
  "water_temperature",
  "depth"
)

spat_corr <- blockCV::cv_spatial_autocor(
  r = continuous_predictors,
  num_sample = 5000,
  plot = TRUE,
  progress = TRUE
)

occ_sac <- blockCV::cv_spatial_autocor(
  x = cv_pts,
  column = "pb",
  plot = TRUE,
  progress = TRUE
)

occ_sac$range
occ_sac$range_table

```

```{r}
block_sizes <- c(500, 1000, 1500, 2500, 3000, 5000)


# Create folds
spatial_folds <- purrr::map(
  block_sizes,
  ~blockCV::cv_spatial(
    x = cv_pts,
    column = "pb",
    r = terra::rast(mask),
    k = 5,
    size = .x, 
    selection = "random",
    iteration = 100,
    seed = 42,
    progress = TRUE,
    report = TRUE,
    plot = TRUE
  )
)

cv_10k_4 <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = cv_pts,
  column = "pb",
  r = terra::rast(mask),
  k = 4,
  size = 10000,
  selection = "random",
  iteration = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  progress = TRUE,
  report = TRUE,
  plot = TRUE
)

cv_12k_4 <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = cv_pts,
  column = "pb",
  r = terra::rast(mask),
  k = 4,
  size = 12500,
  selection = "random",
  iteration = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  progress = TRUE,
  report = TRUE,

)

cv_10k <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = cv_pts,
  column = "pb",
  r = terra::rast(mask),

  size = 10000,
  selection = "random",
  iteration = 1000,

cv_12k <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = cv_pts,

  r = terra::rast(mask),
  k = 3,
  size = 12500,

)

```

```{r}
folds <- spatial_folds$folds_list

cv_models <- vector(
  "list",
  length(folds)
)

cv_evals <- vector(
  "list",
  length(folds)
)

cv_results <- vector(
  "list",
  length(folds)
)

for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

  # Row indices assigned by blockCV
  train_idx <- folds[[i]][[1]]
  test_idx  <- folds[[i]][[2]]

  # Presence coordinates
  p_train <- occ_xy[
    train_idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  p_test <- occ_xy[
    test_idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # Fit MaxEnt
  m <- dismo::maxent(
    x = predictors_raster,
    p = p_train,
    a = bg,
    factors = "sediment",
    removeDuplicates = FALSE
  )

  # Evaluate on held-out occurrence points
  e <- dismo::evaluate(
    p = p_test,
    a = bg,
    model = m,
    x = predictors_raster
  )

  # Store fitted model
  cv_models[[i]] <- m

  # Store evaluation object
  cv_evals[[i]] <- e

  # Store summary metrics
  cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    fold = i,
    train_n = nrow(p_train),
    test_n = nrow(p_test),
    auc = e@auc
  )

  cat(
    "Fold", i,
    "| train:", nrow(p_train),
    "| test:", nrow(p_test),
    "| AUC:", round(e@auc, 3),
    "\n"
  )
}

```

```{r}
cv_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cv_results
)

cv_results

cv_summary <- cv_results %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc),
    sd_auc = sd(auc),
    min_auc = min(auc),
    max_auc = max(auc)
  )

cv_summary

```

```{r}

final_model <- dismo::maxent(
  x = predictors_raster,
  p = occ_xy,
  a = bg,
  factors = "sediment",
  removeDuplicates = FALSE
)

```

```{r}

suitability <- raster::predict(
  final_model,
  predictors_raster
)

suitability <- terra::rast(
  suitability
)

terra::crs(suitability) <- target_crs

names(suitability) <- "maxent_suitability"
```


```{r}

# plot showing importance of each variable
plot(me)

# response curves
response(me)

# predict to entire dataset
r <- predict(me, predictors_raster) 

#testing
# background data
bg <- randomPoints(predictors_raster, 10000)

#simplest way to use 'evaluate'
e1 <- evaluate(me, p=occtest, a=bg, x=predictors_raster)

# alternative 1
# extract values
pvtest <- data.frame(extract(predictors_raster, occtest))
avtest <- data.frame(extract(predictors_raster, bg))

e2 <- evaluate(me, p=pvtest, a=avtest)
e2

# alternative 2 
# predict to testing points 
testp <- predict(me, pvtest) 
head(testp)
testa <- predict(me, avtest) 

e3 <- evaluate(p=testp, a=testa)
e3
threshold(e3)

plot(e3, 'ROC')

terra::crs(pred) <- "ESRI:103021"
terra::crs(r) <- "ESRI:103021"


```
